title: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
key_facts: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, which it calls its fastest and most affordable small model to date.
On average, Haiku 5.5 costs about 75 percent less than Haiku 4.5; for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, prices drop by up to 90 percent.
Prompts longer than 100,000 tokens cost five times as much.
Anthropic says the model suits high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks such as summarization, database queries, classification and live customer support.
An updated tokenizer uses slightly more tokens per task, so real savings are likely smaller than the per-token prices suggest.
Haiku 5.5 scores 72.4 percent on OSWorld-2.1 (computer use), up from 15.7 percent for the predecessor; 45.9 percent on Humanity's Last Exam without tools.
Anthropic cuts the cache-read price for Sonnet 5.5 by 50 percent, from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens.
